objective: Bullish and bearish target generation only; no model retraining.
target_definition: 24h return >=+10% for long, <=-10% for short; separate 24h cooldown per token and side. Best entry in prior24h through anchor; best direction-adjusted exit5m..24h after entry. Neighbors within5m must retain95% of best return.
exit_target: CLOSE at/after side-specific optimum, HOLD before it; force CLOSE at step288.
training_status: Not trained. Existing models are long-only; their runtime cannot consume the new direction labels.
